newsitem.title: USA: Candlewood Hotel says building six hotels.
newsitem.headline: Candlewood Hotel says building six hotels.

text.p: Candlewood Hotel Co Inc said on Monday it is building four company-owned and two franchise-owned hotels in six states.
It did not disclose costs of the construction.
The four company-owned hotels are being built in Denver, Louisville, Omaha, and Cincinnati. The two franchise properties under construction are in Portland and Pleasanton, Calif.
Candlewood Hotel has 22 company-owned sites under contract and has contracts pending on 23 other sites.

Candlewood owns, develops and franchises a hotel brand targeted toward business travelers and offers extended-stay, mid-priced hotels, which it said is characterized by average daily rates of about $40 to $60. ((--Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
